_comment: LoopStar GENERATIVE material pack (LP.6 / Phase ML.4). Genre-authentic DNA for the on-device 'Make it new' generator (LoopStarMaterialEngine). The Swift binary is a SKELETON (RULE #1): it ships a clamped tempo-heuristic fallback and reads THIS file at runtime for the real genre feel. Zero-rebuild to tune. Companion phrase pack: phrases/blues/ (the public-domain cluster). Encoded from docs/idiom-research/genre-jazz-blues-classical.md GENRE 2 (12-BAR BLUES); GM programs 0-based (the source-book lists them 1-based). swing 0.66 = the engine's beat + swing*0.25 offbeat shift, i.e. a true 2:1 shuffle -- corny trap 1 says straight 8ths kill this genre, so this pack swings harder than any other. Schema owner: LoopStarGenrePack.swift.
name: Blues
blurb: Shuffle blues: swung 5-6 guitar dyads over a boogie-woogie walking bass, a hard backbeat behind them, and an overdriven lead leaning on blue thirds and flat sevenths.

flavors.label: Slow Blues
flavors.blurb: Twelve-eight and dragging: chords let ring, everything laid back behind the beat.

flavors.label: Jump Shuffle
flavors.blurb: Texas shuffle: chopped five-six dyads, quick change to the four, boogie bass underneath.

flavors.label: Juke Joint Drone
flavors.blurb: Hill-country one-chord grind: the riff never leaves the one and the time keeps pushing.

flavors.label: Minor Blues
flavors.blurb: Minor twelve with a dominant five: brooding, sustained, the thrill-is-gone shape.

flavors.label: Barrelhouse Boogie
flavors.blurb: Eight-bar piano boogie: a chord every bar, rolling left hand, metronome-tight.

arranger.llmStyleBrief: Blues is dominant sevenths everywhere: I7, IV7 and V7, never a major seventh on the tonic. Twelve-bar and eight-bar forms, the quick change to IV in bar two, the IV to sharp-IV diminished lift in bar six, and a I-VI-ii-V turnaround in the last two bars. Minor blues keeps i7 and iv7 over a dominant V7. Shuffle it hard.
